business_definition: Provider master record containing enrollment and demographic information
National Provider Identifier - unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to healthcare providers
State Medicaid provider identification number - 9-character alphanumeric identifier
Provider classification code - 2-character alphanumeric (X(02))
Condition: provider is an individual practitioner (VALUE 'IN')
Condition: provider is a group practice (VALUE 'GR')
Condition: provider is a healthcare facility (VALUE 'FA')
Healthcare provider taxonomy code - 10-character alphanumeric classification code
Risk assessment tier classification - 1-character alphanumeric (X(01))
Condition: provider assigned limited risk tier (VALUE 'L')
Condition: provider assigned moderate risk tier (VALUE 'M')
Condition: provider assigned high risk tier (VALUE 'H')
Provider enrollment status code - 1-character alphanumeric (X(01))
Condition: provider enrollment status is pending (VALUE 'P')
Condition: provider enrollment status is active (VALUE 'A')
Condition: provider enrollment status is terminated (VALUE 'T')
Condition: provider enrollment status is denied (VALUE 'D')
Provider screening result flag - 1-character alphanumeric (X(01))
Condition: provider has not been screened (VALUE 'U')
Condition: provider passed screening (VALUE 'P')
Condition: provider failed screening (VALUE 'F')
Provider enrollment effective date - 8-digit numeric date (YYYYMMDD format)
Provider re-evaluation due date - 8-digit numeric date (YYYYMMDD format)
Variant data field containing provider-specific information - 80-character alphanumeric (REDEFINES PRV-VARIANT)
Individual provider demographic data group (REDEFINES PRV-VARIANT)
Individual provider last name - 30-character alphanumeric
Individual provider first name - 20-character alphanumeric
Individual provider license number - 15-character alphanumeric
Individual provider license issuing state code - 2-character alphanumeric
Reserved placeholder field used for data structure alignment, padding, or holding constant values
Organization provider data group (REDEFINES PRV-VARIANT)
Organization legal business name - 40-character alphanumeric
Organization doing business as name - 30-character alphanumeric
Organization owner National Provider Identifier - 10-character alphanumeric
Error code group containing validation and status codes
Success status code indicating no errors (VALUE '0000')
Error code for missing National Provider Identifier (VALUE 'E101')
Error code for invalid provider type (VALUE 'E102')
Error code for duplicate National Provider Identifier (VALUE 'E103')
Error code for missing provider taxonomy code (VALUE 'E104')
Error code for excluded provider status (VALUE 'E201')
Error code for expired professional license (VALUE 'E202')
Error code for excluded provider owner (VALUE 'E203')
Error code for deceased provider (VALUE 'E204')
Error code for debarred provider status (VALUE 'E205')
Provider information group containing NPI, Medicaid ID, provider type, taxonomy code, risk tier, enrollment status, effective date, revaluation due date, and legal name
National Provider Identifier (NPI) for the provider (PIC X(10))
Medicaid provider identification number (PIC X(09))
Provider type classification code (PIC X(02))
Healthcare provider taxonomy classification code (PIC X(10))
Risk tier assignment level for the provider (PIC X(01))
Provider enrollment status indicator (PIC X(01))
Date when provider information becomes effective (PIC X(10))
Date when provider revaluation is due (PIC X(10))
Provider legal name group containing length and text fields
Length of provider legal name text in bytes (PIC S9(4) COMP)
Provider legal name text value (PIC X(60))
Screening record containing NPI validation results and source information
National Provider Identifier number (10 characters)
Source system code for screening data (8 characters)
Condition: screening source is NPPES (VALUE 'NPPES')
Condition: screening source is OIG LEIE (VALUE 'OIGLEIE')
Condition: screening source is SAM.GOV (VALUE 'SAMGOV')
Condition: screening source is state license board (VALUE 'LICBOARD')
Condition: screening source is SSA DMF (VALUE 'SSADMF')
Condition: screening source is PECOS (VALUE 'PECOS')
Screening result code (1 character)
Condition: screening result is pass (VALUE 'P')
Condition: screening result is fail (VALUE 'F')
Condition: screening result is conditional (VALUE 'C')
Date of screening verdict in YYYYMMDD format (8 digits)
Detailed screening result message or notes (40 characters)
Standard working storage group containing program control and file processing counters
Program identifier field (8 characters)
End-of-file indicator flag (VALUE 'N')
Condition: end-of-file reached (VALUE 'Y')
File I/O status code (VALUE '00')
Condition: file operation successful (VALUE '00')
Condition: end-of-file encountered (VALUE '10')
Condition: duplicate key error (VALUE '22')
Count of records read from input file (7-digit numeric, VALUE ZERO)
Count of records written to output file (7-digit numeric, VALUE ZERO)
Count of records skipped during processing (7-digit numeric, VALUE ZERO)
Count of records with processing errors (7-digit numeric, VALUE ZERO)
